title: The 529-to-Roth Loophole: $35K Move 90% Miss
hook: You saved in a 529 for college and there's money left over — but most parents have no idea there's a $35,000 tax-free escape hatch built right into the law.
angle: SECURE 2.0 (2024) created a path to roll unused 529 funds into a Roth IRA — most people treat 529s as 'use it for school or lose it' but this new rule changes everything for families with leftover college savings
audience: Parents with 529 accounts, especially those whose kids got scholarships, went to cheaper schools, or have leftover college savings they don't know what to do with
key_numbers: $7,000/year — max annual rollover (matches Roth IRA limit)
15 years — minimum age the 529 account must be
~90% of 529 owners unaware this option exists
$35,000 at age 25 grows to ~$533,000 by retirement tax-free
